item.title: A strong earthquake shakes part of southern Japan but no tsunami detected
item.description: The quake shook Kumamoto, on Japan's southern main island of Kyushu, late Tuesday afternoon local time, causing damage and injuries.

item.title: Trump to meet with Zelenskyy, Netanyahu. And, TPS holders could soon face deportation
item.description: President Trump is set to hold separate meetings with Ukrainian leader Volodymyr Zelenskyy and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu are today. And, Temporary Protected Status holders may face deportation soon.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Netanyahu to meet Trump in a first encounter since the Iran war began
item.description: The meeting comes as both face pressures at home. Netanyahu is up for reelection, embattled in part due to his deteriorating relationship with Trump. Trump is under pressure to end an unpopular war.

item.title: With wildfires raging in France and Spain, fire crews race against next heat wave
item.description: French authorities ordered nearly 4,000 people evacuated Tuesday from tourist sites on the Atlantic coast as returning heat threatened firefighters' fragile hold on a vast wildfire west of Bordeaux.

item.title: France continues to fight devastating wildfires, while progress is made in Spain
item.description: In southern France, a wildfire in the region of Gironde is still active, while two major fires in central Spain are finally coming under control, ahead of the fourth heat wave of the summer.

item.title: Can the U.S. and Iran take the off-ramp?
item.description: The U.S. military has paused its airstrikes on Iran after nearly two weeks of intensifying bombing, while diplomatic efforts have pushed forward to try to avert a return to all-out war.
